description: Ministry Of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port city Economic Commission Act No. 11 of 2021 Order Under Section 53 (CHINA HARBOR ENGINEERING COMPANY (LANKA LIMITED).
categorisation: This gazette content is an Order made under Section 53 of The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It specifies the designation of a business as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance, outlines the rationale for this designation, and details the applicable exemptions or incentives. This constitutes a regulatory matter and the exercise of powers granted by a specific Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While a government minister is named, the primary purpose is not about the personnel change or their portfolio responsibilities, but rather the issuance of a legal order and its accompanying regulatory details.
